description: App icon: a short tower of four rounded blocks in coral #FF7A59, sun #FFC94A, mint #3DDC97 and lilac #9B8CFF stacked slightly offset, the top block sliding in, on a sky blue gradient #8FD8F8 to #3F7FD9.

Boot splash: a tall tower of bright beveled blocks (coral, sun, mint, lilac) rising into a soft sky gradient from light blue #8FD8F8 at the top to deep blue #3F7FD9, with a few soft clouds near the bottom; empty sky in the upper middle for the title.
Font of all text in English: a crisp, friendly geometric sans-serif with a variable weight axis (wght) so titles, buttons and the score use a heavy weight and body text a medium weight.

UI kit reference sheet for the whole game: a rounded navy #1E2A4A panel with a 2 px cream #F4E7C5 frame and a soft inner shadow, a large gold #FFB627 rounded button and a navy rounded button with a light top highlight, a small dark inset plate, a gold crown icon, all in the same bright flat casual style with gentle bevels on a plain light background.

Backdrop of the title, lobby and run: a soft vertical sky gradient from light sky blue #8FD8F8 at the top to deep blue #3F7FD9 at the bottom, with a few very soft white clouds low on the screen and no horizon line or ground; the middle is calm and empty so the tower and the text read over it; code tints it darker as the tower rises.

One stacking block seen from the side, filling the whole image: a near-white #F7F7F7 rounded rectangle with a lighter top face band, gentle bevelled edges and a slightly darker bottom edge, no outline; code tints it coral, sun, mint or lilac and stretches it to any width, so the left and right ends stay the same and the middle is plain.

Frame of every panel and popup (lobby record, option panel, pause popup, result panel, terms popup, system popup): a rounded navy #1E2A4A panel with a 2 px cream #F4E7C5 frame, a soft inner shadow and a slightly lighter top edge; plain middle so it stretches.

Every button and the header band of panels: a near-white #F7F7F7 rounded pill-shaped plate with a light top highlight and a soft darker bottom lip, no text; code tints it gold #FFB627 for main actions and navy #2E3D66 for secondary actions, and stretches it.
Best score icon: a small gold #FFB627 crown with three rounded points and a light top highlight, soft shadow, transparent background.
A block lands on the tower (trim or perfect) and every UI button press: a short soft wooden tock, warm and dry, pleasant when heard every second.
A perfect drop: a bright, clean glassy chime with a short sparkle tail, rewarding and upbeat.
The run ends: the missed block slides off and falls, a soft descending whoosh and a dull low thud, a gentle sting, not harsh.
BGM of the lobby and the run: a calm, upbeat lo-fi loop with soft marimba, warm keys and light percussion at about 92 BPM, relaxing and steady so the drop sounds stay on top; loops seamlessly.
Title scene of the boot: the game name, the tagline and a small three-block tower over the sky.
Lobby scene: the sky backdrop under the lobby panel.
Run scene: the sky, the base slab, the tower and the sliding block under the HUD.
Loading screen of every scene transition: the loading text and a block bar over the sky.
Terms consent popup of a new user: agree to all, the two agree toggles with their view buttons, the hint and confirm.
Frame of every system popup (confirms, notices, errors) in the panel art.
Loading icon of server requests: a gold block that turns.
Root panel of the lobby: title, record line, options, best score plate, demo tower and Play.
Option panel: sound toggles, user code, account deletion, withdrawal, terms, privacy and licenses.
Root panel of the run: score, streak badge, best score plate, getting ready text and the drop hint.
Pause popup of the run: End run and Resume.
Result panel of a run: title, counting score, best score, perfect drops, best streak, Lobby and Play again.
One tower block: the tinted block art with its landing squash and perfect glow (pooled).
A falling piece: the cut overhang or the missed block that drops, spins and fades (pooled).
Opening of every panel and popup: rises into place and fades in.
Opening of a system popup: fades in.
Closing of every panel and popup: fades out.
Press bounce of every button.
Turn of the loading icon block.
The demo block sliding left and right on top of the lobby tower.
Breathing of the lobby Play button.
Landing squash of a placed block.
White glow of a perfect drop that widens and fades.
Fall of a cut piece or the missed block: drops, spins away from the tower and fades.
Scroll of the tower view to the next level (target set at run time).
Pop of the score on each drop.
Pop of the streak badge on a perfect drop, then fade out.
Short white screen flash of a perfect drop.
Red screen flash of the miss.
Duration and easing of the score count up on the result panel.
First result row sliding in.
Second result row sliding in.
Third result row sliding in.
